text: In this unit Alex travels to Munich with Max, and the delayed train, a complaint and the hotel test their German. In this unit you will buy tickets, find your platform, check in at an airport or a hotel, book a bed in a hostel, and deal with problems such as a delay or a broken shower. The scenes are set in places you may know: a ticket counter, a train, an airport, a hotel and a hostel.
Listen to the dialogues first, then work through the other sections in any order.
